_comment: Web-sweep config for /job-hunt-scan Step 3b. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: edit 'titles' + 'boolean' once and every sweep query rebuilds from it (the skill composes each query/URL — sweeps no longer hard-code the Boolean). 'websearch' sweeps run via the WebSearch tool (work everywhere, incl. widget-refresh window); 'browser' sweeps need the Chrome MCP (logged-in LinkedIn/Dice/Indeed) or the in-app browser and skip gracefully with a note if unavailable. Titles = Andrew's dashboard dropdown families + the recurring variants from the 120-day email scan (job-title-search-list.md), containment-tuned: e.g. 'Power BI Developer' already matches 'Senior Power BI Developer' as a phrase, so seniority prefixes are omitted. Bias is recall — the /job-hunt-scan grader is the precision filter (keeps only strong fits >=65).
boolean: ("Power BI Developer" OR "Power BI Engineer" OR "Power BI Architect" OR "Power BI Analyst" OR "BI Developer" OR "BI Analyst" OR "Business Intelligence Developer" OR "Business Intelligence Engineer" OR "Business Intelligence Analyst" OR "Microsoft Fabric Developer" OR "Azure Data Engineer" OR "Analytics Engineer" OR "Data Integration Engineer" OR "Senior Data Analyst" OR "BI Engineer" OR "BI Lead" OR "Senior Data Engineer" OR "Lead Data Engineer" OR "ETL Developer" OR "ETL Consultant" OR "Data Warehouse Developer" OR "Business Information Analyst")

_commentBatches: websearch sweeps run ONCE PER BATCH (2 queries per sweep) because Google truncates queries past ~32 words; the full 'boolean' stays for browser sweeps (LinkedIn/Dice/Indeed URLs handle long booleans). Batches are the containment-minimal cover of 'titles' ('Power BI Developer' is already matched by 'BI Developer', etc.), split BI-core vs data-eng/ETL, ORDERED highest-value-first so any truncation only drops the rarest tail phrases. REGENERATE both batches when 'titles' changes.

hybridLocal._comment: Exception to the remote-only rule (added 2026-07-22). Hybrid postings within radiusMiles of homeZip are eligible ONLY when they grade >= minScore AND state comp at/above the career-plan floor (annual >= compFloorAnnual or rate >= compFloorHourly). Qualifiers merge with tier 'look' - NEVER 'strong' - so they surface on the dashboard/widget Worth-a-Look bucket without diluting the remote-first strong list. Onsite 5-days and hybrid beyond the radius stay dropped. Sweeps flagged hybridLocal:true exist to FIND these; the grading exception applies to alert-email hits too.
